english.title: Fail to comply with a duty under s.790G to notify company on becoming a PSC
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a registrable

(A)_[person]_
(B)_[relevant legal entity]_

in relation to a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), failed, when for a period of at least one month you knew that to be the case or ought reasonably to have done so, your required particulars were not stated in the company’s PSC register and you had not received notice from the company under section 790D(2) of the Companies Act 2006, to notify the company of your status as a registrable

(C)_[person]_
(D)_[relevant legal entity]_

in relation to the company, state the date to the best of your knowledge on which you acquired that status and give the company the required particulars under section 790K of the Act within the required time limits
english.legislation: Contrary to section 790G of, and paragraph 14 of Schedule 1B to, the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine. The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022. Time limit for prosecutions:
